scope.notes: Targets are only existing DMG p.225 fieldSources bindings for the 29 specified equipment owners. Ten citation-only row records, absent table rows and all other p.225 reference objects remain out of this mapping. The 64-row denominator and root classifications are carried from the independent source review; this proposal does not relabel the rest of the table.

method.sourceFirst: Read the authorized original DMG PDF p.225 pixels before mapping; no OCR/search occurrence alone establishes a row join.

coordinateFrame.name: PyMuPDF Page.rect / PDF CropBox, top-left origin, points

completeTableClip.contents: Complete Appendix O table: heading, Item/Encumbrance in gold pieces headings, all 64 rows, starred musical-instrument qualifier and footnote, max-load paragraph and exclusion-list lead-in. It does not include the right-column continuation.

rightColumnMeaningClip.contents: Right-column continuation completes the exclusion list, explains how to infer unlisted items, and states that encumbrance combines weight and relative bulkiness rather than literal object weight.

method.manualVisualReview: Individually opened and reviewed the original p.225 render with folio, the shared full-table and right-column images, all 18 current p.225 public image files, all 26 table-row focus overlays, both thieves-tools passage overlays, and the two historical Lantern/Mirror table overlays. The target source rows and qualifiers were compared to actual pixels. The 64-row source denominator and full-book row classifications are carried from the separately hashed root independent review, not claimed as a new 64-row audit.

sourcePixelReadingNotes.note: PyMuPDF selectable text returns “Lanfern”. That text layer is not treated as the source. The original 216-dpi rendered page and the complete d1 table crop visibly show “Lantern”; the two focus boxes were checked on those pixels and cover the label/value cells.
Numeric/report transcriptions from the root row audit were checked against actual source pixels and focus overlays; PDF text extraction was not used as the semantic denominator or as proof of a join.

method.defaultPreservationPolicy: For Lantern, Silver Mirror and Iron Spike, candidate aliases append after all existing owner catalog regions. Existing default region selection remains the same; because the viewer hashes the complete same-page region group, its post-addition defaultOrderSha256 changes and is explicitly left pending independent review. No default selection change or approval is proposed.
